The primary values are 273.1525 K for melting at 101.325 kPa (W. Wagner, T. Riethmann, R. Feistel and A. H. Harvey, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 40 (2011) 043103, doi:10.1063/1.3657937) and 373.124 K for the normal boiling point on ITS-90 (W. Wagner and A. Pruss, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 31 (2002) 387-535, doi:10.1063/1.1461829); the shipped constants differ from them by 0.003 K and 0.026 K, inside the apparatus's stated 0.5 K, and are kept so the two routes cannot disagree.
